Judicial In-Rem Sales Advantage in Henry County, Georgia

Are you looking to acquire properties at unbeatable prices with hassle-free ownership and rapid marketability? Judicial In-Rem Sales in Henry County, Georgia, offer just that. This type of tax sale is an excellent way to get properties free of liens and other claims, making the ownership process smoother and quicker.

How Do Judicial In-Rem Sales Work?

In Georgia, there are two primary types of tax sales: Judicial In-Rem Tax Sales and Non-Judicial Tax Sales. Henry County primarily uses the Judicial In-Rem Tax Sale process. These sales occur on the first Tuesday of each month at the Henry County Administration Building located at 140 Henry Parkway, McDonough, Georgia 30253.

Henry County Tax Sale Key Details:

  • Auction Schedule: First Tuesday of each month at 10:00 AM
  • Location: 140 Henry Parkway, McDonough, GA 30253
  • Registration: Pre-register online and verify funds prior to bidding. Bring a photo ID, address, phone number, and proof of funds. Registration starts at 9:15 AM on the day of the sale.
  • Payment: Acceptable forms include cash, money orders, and certified checks. They do not accept personal checks.
  • Bidding Process: Bidders can only bid up to the amount of certified funds they have verified. The highest bidder wins the property.
  • Redemption Period: The property owner has 60 days from the sale date to redeem the property by paying the redemption amount. If the property is not redeemed, the purchaser will receive the title within 90 days.

For more information on the registration and bidding process, visit the Henry County Tax Commissioner’s website.

Today’s Pro Tip

Understand how Judicial In-Rem Sales work because this is where you can buy properties far below market rates. These properties come free and clear of any liens or claims, thanks to court orders. You’ll get your tax deed within 90 days when you purchase through this process, provided the property isn’t redeemed. This eliminates the hassle of post-sale barments and the lengthy “Quiet Title” process in most cases, giving you a clean title and increased marketability for your investment.

FAQs

What is the advantage of a Judicial In-Rem Tax Sale?

  • Judicial In-Rem Tax Sales provide properties free of liens and other claims, offering clean titles for quick marketability and use.

How do I register for the Henry County Tax Sale?

  • You must pre-register online by providing a photo ID, address, phone number, and proof of funds. Registration starts at 9:15 AM on the day of the sale.

What forms of payment are accepted?

  • Accepted forms of payment include cash, money orders, and certified checks. Personal checks are not accepted.

What happens if the property is redeemed?

  • If the property is redeemed within the 60-day redemption period, the purchaser will receive a refund of their purchase price, and the foreclosure action is dismissed.
